tools.name: find_demo_accounts
tools.description: Search ForexDemo.com's research on Forex demo accounts at 59 brokers by broker, platform, the country of the broker company and how long the demo lasts. Returns each demo's time limit, starting virtual money, the date it was checked, the broker's demo sign-up page and the ForexDemo.com page.

tools.name: get_demo_account
tools.description: Full ForexDemo.com research for one demo account, by the id from find_demo_accounts: the company that provides it, how long it lasts, the virtual money, the date checked, the sign-up page and the broker's own pages the facts come from.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ForexDemo.com's calculators, brokers and demo account research by keywords. Returns up to 10 results, each with an id for fetch, a title and the ForexDemo.com address.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one ForexDemo.com search result in full by its id from search: a calculator with its inputs and a worked example, a broker with all its researched demo accounts, or one demo account.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calculate_profit, calculate_margin · Public sink: calculate_account_survival, calculate_kelly · Destructive: calculate_drawdown.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: calculate_profit, calculate_margin · Public sink: calculate_account_survival, calculate_kelly · Destructive: calculate_drawdown

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
